description: Start 2-10 parameter variants against the same saved revision, same date window, and same current BotSpot Auto routing policy. BotSpot creates or resolves one immutable strategy parameter set per variant and starts the runs in parallel with bounded concurrency through the normal backtest entitlement and runtime path. Use this when the user asks to compare parameter values; do not edit strategy code between variants. Read the saved strategy first and use the exact parameter key from the saved strategy code, including its casing; never rename, uppercase, or infer a different environment-variable-style key. The result returns an experiment id, exact revision id, parameter-set ids, routing-policy snapshot, every successfully started backtest id, and any start failures. This tool does not return an externalWaitId: do not invent one or call record_external_wait_in_plan for the experiment id; monitor each returned backtest id with backtest_status or one complete list_backtests read. After starting, wait for every returned backtest id to reach a terminal state, report failures or missing artifacts, and compare the complete set on the same window. Do not blindly recommend the highest in-sample return; include drawdown, risk-adjusted metrics, trade count, parameters, and observed data provenance, then recommend out-of-sample or walk-forward validation. This always uses the conversation data provider; no dataProvider or raw botConfig input is accepted.

budget.description: Starting cash for the backtest (in the quote currency, typically USD). Sets BACKTESTING_BUDGET in the backtest environment.

envVarSetIds.description: Saved BotSpot environment variable IDs to inject into the backtest runner. The MCP server never reads or exposes the saved values; BotSpot issues a short-lived runtime secret for the backtest.
